mapper.select: SELECT context_version FROM iam_refresh_token_families WHERE id = #{familyId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, family_id, idempotency_key, target_membership_id, target_fingerprint, expected_context_version, switch_status, result_http_status, created_at, completed_at, refreshed_at FROM iam_tenant_context_switches WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}

SELECT id, family_id, idempotency_key, target_membership_id, target_fingerprint, expected_context_version, switch_status, result_http_status, created_at, completed_at, refreshed_at FROM iam_tenant_context_switches WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND switch_status IN ('PENDING', 'AWAITING_REFRESH')

SELECT id, family_id, idempotency_key, target_membership_id, target_fingerprint, expected_context_version, switch_status, result_http_status, created_at, completed_at, refreshed_at FROM iam_tenant_context_switches WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND switch_status = 'AWAITING_REFRESH'

INSERT INTO iam_tenant_context_switches (family_id, idempotency_key, target_membership_id, target_fingerprint, expected_context_version, switch_status, result_http_status, created_at, completed_at, refreshed_at) VALUES (#{row.familyId}, #{row.idempotencyKey}, #{row.targetMembershipId}, #{row.targetFingerprint}, #{row.expectedContextVersion}, #{row.switchStatus}, #{row.resultHttpStatus}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.completedAt}, #{row.refreshedAt}) RETURNING id, family_id, idempotency_key, target_membership_id, target_fingerprint, expected_context_version, switch_status, result_http_status, created_at, completed_at, refreshed_at
